candidates.name: search_heuristics_guidance
candidates.hypothesis: Providing domain-general search guidance in context_mgmt—instructing the agent to break complex queries into key entities, avoid over-quoting long sentences, and actively fetch full documents with get_document when snippets contain promising leads—will reduce repetitive search spinning and increase validation pass rate to >45% while decreasing average turns.
candidates.changes: Set default extra_system in context_mgmt/default.py with domain-general information retrieval heuristics (flexible query keywords without rigid quotes, decomposing multi-hop clues, and actively inspecting documents with get_document).
candidates.expected_efficiency: Pass rate increases to ~45-50%, mean turns reduce from 21.3 to ~17-18 due to fewer dead-end repeated searches.
